page.title: Money flow
page.description: Income, contributions, joint outgoings and the joint accounts, month by month.

setup.title: Set up the joint accounts
setup.description: Add your joint current account and joint savings account with their balance today. From then on the app follows contributions, transfers and paid joint expenses; when it drifts from the bank, set the real balance.

accounts.title: Joint accounts
accounts.addSavingsDescription: Follow the joint savings account too: transfers, interest and its balance.
accounts.addJointDescription: Add the joint current account the contributions go to.

ledger.title: History
ledger.label: Account history
ledger.empty: Nothing happened on this account this month.
ledger.deleteDescription: The balance is recomputed without it. A transfer disappears from both accounts.

income.title: Income in
income.none: No income planned or received this month.

contributions.title: Contributions
contributions.description: Planned vs actually transferred this month, per person.
contributions.none: No contributions planned. Add how much each person transfers every month.
contributions.absorbed: already in a later real balance: counts for the plan, didn't change the balance

settlement.title: What still needs to happen
settlement.takeBack: {{name}}: take back {{amount}} (or keep it as extra)
settlement.nettingSimple: Or: {{from}} pays {{to}} {{amount}} directly and transfers {{rest}} to {{account}}. Same end result.
settlement.nettingExact: Or: {{from}} pays {{to}} {{amount}} directly. Same end result.
settlement.nettingIntro: Or, with the same end result:
settlement.settled: Everyone transferred what was planned: {{total}} on {{account}}.
settlement.directDescription: The joint balance stays the same: it counts as {{amount}} more from {{from}} and {{amount}} less from {{to}}. Record {{from}}'s own transfer to the account separately.

coverage.title: Joint costs covered?
coverage.description: Planned contributions vs this month's joint costs (paid + still to pay).
coverage.leftOver: Contributions cover the joint costs: {{amount}} left over
coverage.noPlans: No contributions planned to the joint account yet.
coverage.projectionTitle: Joint account at the end of the month
coverage.projectionDetail: {{balance}} now + {{receive}} still to come in − {{pay}} still to pay
coverage.belowZero: The joint account goes below zero on {{date}} (lowest {{amount}}).
coverage.belowZeroNow: The joint account is below zero now.
coverage.updateHint: From {{date}}; earlier months keep their plan.

projects.title: Projects
projects.placeholder: Project budgets show up here once projects exist.

fields.name: Name
fields.openingDescription: The balance on this date becomes the opening balance (a correction in the history).
fields.isDefaultDescription: Joint expenses without an account are paid from it.
fields.balanceDescription: What the bank shows. The difference is recorded as a correction; no fake bills or incomes.
fields.activeFromDescription: A new amount from a later date keeps the old amount for earlier months.

form.transferDescription: Who (or which account) put money into a joint account.
form.otherTitle: Other money in or out of {{name}}
form.beforeCorrection: Before the real balance set on {{date}}, which already includes it: the balance doesn't change. It still counts for that month's contributions.
form.onCorrectionDay: Same day as the real balance set on {{date}}: it's added on top of that balance. If the bank already showed it then, pick an earlier date.
form.takeBackDescription: {{name}} takes money back out of the joint account. It lowers the balance and counts against {{name}}'s contributions this month.

errors.Choose where the money comes from: Choose where the money comes from
errors.openingBalance: The opening balance can't be deleted; set the real balance instead.

loans.title: Loans and down payments
loans.empty: No loans or down payments running.
loans.ofTotal: {{percent}}% of {{total}} repaid since the amounts were entered.
loans.noTotal: Add the total still open to follow what's left.

timeline.title: Income and expenses per month
timeline.description: What came in and went out, and what's coming: expenses step down as loans end.
timeline.error: Couldn't load the income and expenses.
timeline.empty: Nothing to show yet: add incomes and expenses.
timeline.actual: What came in and was paid.
timeline.currentHint: Paid so far plus what's still expected this month.
timeline.projectedHint: Projected from recurring incomes and expenses.
timeline.summaryLower: Projected expenses drop from {{from}} to {{to}} a month in {{month}}.
